title: Holder record (laptop, internal)
description: The keeper's record of the holder it started, <state folder>\board-holder.json for the box, and a file of the same form for each other host (D30, D50, D55). Internal: it is not part of the lease contract, and only the keeper reads it. Absent when there is no holder. The PID and the start time together are the holder's identity. From v0.12 a host is keyed by its project and its platform (D91): the record's file name carries the host's name, board-holder.<project>.<os>-<arch>.json for a host of a platform other than linux/arm64 (architect, 2026-11-26, for v0.12-T01, pin P12), and the record gains platform (pins P5 and P14; docs/state.md, "The holder record" and "Another host's holder"). A record whose platform, linux/arm64 when absent, is not the platform of the host its file is named for is not a record, which this schema cannot check. Strict, as written; a reader is more tolerant (docs/state.md, "The holder record"). Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n).

process_started_at.description: The holder's creation time, UTC, truncated to the millisecond.

lease_id.description: The normalized ID of the lease the holder holds through.

alias.description: That lease's ssh.host_alias, which the holder was started with, in the lease contract's form agentspace-<project>-<first 8 hex digits of the id>. A reader MAY accept any ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}, as the prototype does.

platform.description: From v0.12 (D91; architect, 2026-11-26, for v0.12-T01, pins P5 and P14): the platform of the host the holder is on, the normalized platform in the form of hosts.state.schema.json's platform. Absent means linux/arm64. A writer omits it for linux/arm64 and writes it for every other platform, and a reader takes an explicit linux/arm64 as equal to absent (pin P16). Written last, after alias.
